FISHING LICENCE · LUXEMBOURG

Luxembourg fishing licence

Anglers aged 14 and above need an inland fishing permit. Private category 2 waters also require the owner's written permission; border waters have a separate permit system.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • People aged 14 and above who fish in inland waters.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 14 can fish without a permit with one hand-held line or fly rod.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Ordinary inland permitany1 monthEUR 4
Special A inland permitany1 monthEUR 6
Special B inland permitany1 monthEUR 8

Extra stamps and permits

  • Private-water written permission
    For category 2 waters, in addition to the inland permit.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the permit and an identity document.
  • Carry the owner's written permission for private water.
  • Choose special A for category 1 bank fishing or special B for boat fishing there.

How to buy

Apply and pay through MyGuichet.lu without an account, or buy from the listed permit offices.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Luxembourg?

Anglers aged 14 and above need an inland fishing permit. Private category 2 waters also require the owner's written permission; border waters have a separate permit system.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Luxembourg?

Ordinary inland permit: EUR 4; Special A inland permit: EUR 6; Special B inland permit: EUR 8 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Luxembourg?

Apply and pay through MyGuichet.lu without an account, or buy from the listed permit offices.
